Suicide cannot be explained by a single reason.
Physical and mental health, the hard things met in a life, and social conditions such as poverty, loneliness and discrimination are always tangled together (WHO 2023).
It can be prevented, and many people who go through such a crisis come through it with help and live on.
If things feel very hard right now, please reach out: {@c}. Someone will listen.
